recap.text: Dmitri and Maxim Popov are Nodling crawlers listed as one entry on the top-ten leaderboard. They are an Illusionist and Bogatyr at level thirty with a bounty of one hundred thousand gold. Odette tells guests that the Popov brothers butted heads with team Cichociemni.

Langley, level thirty-two, explains that large groups are forming. The Popov brothers seek archers to hunt team Cichociemni to break up player-killer groups. On the board, the brothers are fifth at level forty-three with two hundred thousand, doubled.

Dmitri and Maxim Popov are two brothers sharing one nodling body. Dmitri is a Visionary and Maxim is a Bogatyr with a meteor hammer. After fighting mantis nymphs in a ballroom, a flaming sambhur's antlers pierce the brothers. They split into two naked baby ogres before blinking out to a surface facility because children are ineligible.

On race day, crawler Elle McGibbons reports from a building of apartments furnished by the AI. She believes she is in the mother's apartment of Dmitri and Maxim Popov. Pictures of the brothers are everywhere, and the eyes of the mother and a poodle are sewn shut. Prepotente notes the mother was a fan of pink.

beats.headline: Ninth on the board
beats.text: Top-ten leaderboard, bounty column. Ninth: Dmitri and Maxim Popov, Nodling, Illusionist and Bogatyr, level thirty, one hundred thousand gold. Two names, one race, one level, one bounty, one line. Tenth is Ifechi. The list does not explain how two crawlers came to share a single entry. Crawler Princess Donut does remark on it: if those two get to share a spot, it is not fair, and she and Crawler Carl should both be number three.
beats.gist: Dmitri and Maxim Popov share one entry on the leaderboard as a level thirty Nodling.

beats.headline: Butting heads with Cichociemni
beats.text: Odette, on air between floors, running through the season's best stories for the benefit of her guests: the battle with Grull, Prepotente and Miriam Dom losing a province boss twice, Quan Ch, the hilarious but ultimately tragic fight between Lucia Mar, Florin and Ifechi. Not to mention the Popov brothers butting heads with team Cichociemni. That is the entire mention. It establishes a feud, and that the feud made television.
beats.gist: Odette tells guests that the Popov brothers butted heads with team Cichociemni.

beats.headline: Recruiting archers for a hunt
beats.text: Langley, level thirty-two and leaving with his group, lays out their options for the next floor. Large groups are forming. The Popov brothers are looking for archers, because they want to hunt down team Cichociemni, who have been preying on weak crawlers, and the player-killer groups need breaking up before they get too strong. His group may join them. On the board that closes this floor the brothers are fifth: level forty-three, two hundred thousand, doubled.
beats.gist: The Popov brothers seek archers to hunt team Cichociemni and break up player-killer groups.

beats.headline: A giant foot on the replay
beats.text: Recap footage from the last moments of the previous floor. One of the two heads screams "Murderer!" The two-headed nodling is fighting a big, leather-clad man with a shaved head and a war gauntlet, and their magical meteor hammer is about to brain him when a giant foot crashes into the scene and everyone goes flying. It belongs to Slit. The target runs for a stairwell. In the specialisation rundown, Dmitri goes from Illusionist to Visionary; the other half remains a Bogatyr.
beats.gist: Dmitri and Maxim Popov are two-headed nodling brothers in one body.

beats.headline: What a nodling does at death
beats.text: Tsarina Signet, explaining her ogre Areson, supplies the relevant biology. When a nodling dies, it splits into new creatures, one per head. They emerge as toddlers and grow quickly, and the original body remains. A nodling may have anywhere from two heads to six, usually two or three. Crawler Princess Donut asks whether that is what the Popov brothers are. Crawler Carl says yes, and that it raises more questions than it answers about two men who picked that race.
beats.gist: Tsarina Signet explains that dying nodlings split into toddlers, one per head, while the body remains.

beats.headline: Whisked away to a convention
beats.text: Crawler Elle McGibbons, briefing at speed. Team Cichociemni killed their own leader because he did not want them to be a group of murderers, and that leader was friendly with the Popovs, before Dmitri accidentally picked a race that combined him with his brother. The Popovs had Cichociemni cornered when the brothers were whisked away to CrawlCon. They have been gone two days and are back tomorrow. According to them, they are sharing a table with Crawler Carl.
beats.gist: Dmitri and Maxim Popov are two brothers in one body who share a table with Carl.

beats.headline: Kapitan Whiskers, orange
beats.text: The green room. About seven feet tall, broad, grey and callused like an elephant. Dmitri, the Visionary, has the right side and a bare, round head. Maxim, the Bogatyr, has a beanie and the meteor hammer. Fraternal twins: not identical before, not identical now. Dmitri is disappointed the cat has not come, and Maxim apologises for him. Dmitri had just got a cat, orange, named Kapitan Whiskers, the day before it happened. Maxim complains they were promised food and given one chicken.
beats.gist: Dmitri and Maxim Popov are fraternal twins sharing one grey, callused body in the green room.

beats.headline: For the thousandth time
beats.text: Autograph session. Dmitri signs everything and chats; Maxim looks bored. A blob child asks whether it was really an accident. Dmitri, for the thousandth time: their game guide, Hongrish, told him the nodling was a good choice that would give him an extra life. He did not say it would force his brother into the same body. When the child presses a theory about a television programme, Maxim threatens it with his foot. Asked about Bogdon Ro's death, Maxim says cheerfully that the man got what he deserved, and he is sorry others had to die too.
beats.gist: Dmitri and Maxim Popov are two brothers sharing one body.

beats.headline: The hammer in the ballroom
beats.text: The ballroom fills with gore and mantis nymphs from above and below, and the Popovs swing their meteor hammer through the room, twisting and shouting as they destroy the nymphs. Around them Prepotente throws potion bottles, Li Na throws chains for her brother to dance along, and Florin works a shotgun from the corner until the blasts become a beat. Mantises still surge in through the doorway.
beats.gist: The Popovs swing a meteor hammer through a ballroom of gore and mantis nymphs.

beats.headline: I miss my cat
beats.text: The final arena. A meteor hammer brains an elf coming at Crawler Carl out of the dark, and the Popovs stand guard while Crawler Princess Donut's mass heal drags him back awake. Then a sambhur, one of the elf mounts, on fire and covered in nymphs, comes spinning through the dark on one of Queen Imogen's spells. Its antlers go straight through the two-headed ogre. The double crawler hits the ground beside Carl. "I miss my cat," Dmitri says, just before he closes his eyes.
beats.gist: Dmitri and Maxim Popov die after a burning sambhur's antlers pierce the two-headed ogre.

beats.headline: Nodling Yearling, ineligible
beats.text: Katia Grim's Find Crawler skill points into a pile of gore, and under it are two fat, naked baby ogres about a year old: Maxim and Dmitri Popov, Level X, Nodling Yearling. They wake. The label over them reads Ineligible, and they blink out. Zev's explanation to Crawler Carl: children and pregnant crawlers are not allowed. Their game guide had them pick that race knowing this would happen. They have been transferred to the kinder facility on the surface. They are free.
beats.gist: Katia Grim's Find Crawler skill reveals baby ogres Maxim and Dmitri Popov in a pile of gore.

beats.headline: Their mother's apartment
beats.text: Race day, through a building of apartments the AI has furnished as what-ifs for crawlers it finds interesting. Crawler Elle McGibbons reports from one of them: she believes it is the Popov twins' mother's apartment. There are pictures of Dmitri and Maxim everywhere, the mother's eyes are sewn shut, and so are the eyes of a poodle. Prepotente notes that the mother appears to have been a big fan of pink.
beats.gist: Elle McGibbons reports from an apartment with pictures of the Popov twins and a blind poodle.

relations.note: Her foot broke up their fight on the recap
